theme: A day of Mike's medical appointments, capped by a late Tokyo call.
greeting: Today's shape is mostly Mike's, Dan — a throat ultrasound and a brain MRI to clear him before tomorrow's oral surgery, then a Jomon call to Tokyo to close the night.

needsAttention.title: Fill Mike's scripts and stock soft food
needsAttention.detail: Mike's oral surgery is tomorrow in Portland and you're his ride home, so today is the day to fill the prescriptions and lay in soft food — yogurt, broth, eggs, no straws. It's the Aug 19 line on your surgery-prep task, overdue since the 14th.

needsAttention.title: Come to the IMC research call with a view
needsAttention.detail: Mike Lubrano's call tomorrow night pulls you and Chie at NRI into shaping the next stage of the IMC research; the open question on the thread is how to bring players beyond asset managers and owners into the discussion. Worth arriving holding a thought or two.

flagged.title: NACD New England reception, Sept 15
flagged.detail: The NACD's New England chapter asked you to RSVP for their Sept 15 appreciation reception — an easy yes worth sending given the board search.

flagged.title: The Conor Kehoe intro is still hanging
flagged.detail: Your note to the PRI's Conor never landed — the address bounced twice and Eugenia resent the corrected one, so the ball is back with you.

flagged.title: Maine ferry and Dubrovnik flight booked
flagged.detail: Confirmations arrived for the Maine State Ferry and the Dubrovnik flight — travel logistics are squared away.

inbox.noise: The usual promos and newsletters — Blaze, SiriusXM, NYT Cooking, Foreign Affairs, Responsible Investor, a couple of shop lists.
inbox.clear: Nothing else is asking for you; the rest is confirmations and reading.

resolved.title: Amra closed the Sustainalytics loop
resolved.detail: BlackRock's Amra replied to your stewardship question and caught up on Croatia — the thread's done bar a friendly hello back.

resolved.title: Tomorrow's IMC call is on the calendar
resolved.detail: Mike Lubrano sent the Teams invite and you confirmed the time, so the Chie and Valoris research call is set.

recipe.title: Composed summer salad with french feta
recipe.why: High summer on the Maine coast has the farmstands at their peak, and a composed salad lets ripe tomatoes and briny French feta carry a warm, low-effort evening on your own.

acts.line: Mike's throat ultrasound at 9:30 is the one fixed point before noon.
His brain MRI at 3:30, then a five o'clock haircut.
An 8 o'clock Zoom with Jomon in Tokyo closes the day out.
